items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: I loved Hoagie... I wish I had had the chance to do an album of him... my brother-in-law’s widow is married to Hoagy Carmichael’s stepson. Clear as mud, right? But so we share that.

ctx.x: I see you have a vocal on this too.

I sang “I Can’t Get Started.” Not good, but darn it, Bunny wasn’t much of a singer. This is Jack Keller, who lives in Florida. Wendell Marshall, you know played with Duke’s band, a great bass player. I loved Hoagie, and I’ll go into part of the reasoning why, a great writer, a great songwriter. I wish I had had the chance to do an album of him. You know I did others.
Yeah. It’s a challenge writing backgrounds for trumpet and baritone.
